t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Purple, brown and red wizards will provide red baskets and Yellow, pink and blue wizards will provide yellow baskets. If the score is 15 keep using the same baskets untill the score starts to drop

vb_textbox.text: There are two colours of baskets, represented by wizards. Any yellow, green, blue or orange wizard will provide you with a yellow basket. A purple, pink, brown or red wizard will provide you with a red basket. As the game progresses you will notice you earn more mushrooms depending on the colour basket you use, red or yellow. If for example you are earning lots more witg the red basket , contuine to choose any of the applicable wizards. Eventually the number of mushrooms will decrese so, when this happens now move onto the yellow basket- available through the applicable wizards. *handy hint- if the number of mushrooms collected starts to drop below 15, maybe try and start collecting from the oppiste colou basket
